title: Assam: Akhil Gogoi protests at Zubeen Kshetra, demands rejection of prime accused’s bail plea

ai.summary: Akhil Gogoi, a Raijor Dal chief and Sivasagar MLA, joined a protest at Zubeen Garg Kshetra in Sonapur demanding the rejection of the prime accused's bail plea in the case of late singer Zubeen Garg's death.

facts.claim: Akhil Gogoi, a Raijor Dal chief and Sivasagar MLA, joined a protest at Zubeen Garg Kshetra in Sonapur
facts.quote: Raijor Dal chief and Sivasagar MLA Akhil Gogoi on November 28 joined a protest and human chain at Zubeen Garg Kshetra in Sonapur, organised by the Zubeen Garg Nyay Samiti, demanding justice for late singer Zubeen Garg.

facts.claim: more than a year has passed since Garg’s death but justice is yet to be delivered
facts.quote: Addressing the gathering, Gogoi said more than a year has passed since Garg’s death but justice is yet to be delivered.

facts.claim: the Assam Chief Minister’s statement in the Legislative Assembly describing the incident as murder allegedly carried out by one person with the assistance of four others
facts.quote: Referring to the Assam Chief Minister’s statement in the Legislative Assembly describing the incident as murder allegedly carried out by one person with the assistance of four others,

facts.claim: Gogoi questioned the release of several accused from jail
facts.quote: Gogoi questioned the release of several accused from jail.

facts.claim: the Supreme Court is scheduled to hold the final hearing on November 30 on the bail petition of the prime accused in the case
facts.quote: He said the Supreme Court is scheduled to hold the final hearing on November 30 on the bail petition of the prime accused in the case.

facts.claim: Gogoi urged the Assam and Union governments to ensure that the bail plea is rejected
facts.quote: He urged the Assam and Union governments to ensure that the bail plea is rejected, maintaining that the prime accused should not be granted bail.
